verdict.rationale: Puzzle's own docs describe a built-in AI you can delegate work to. AI Close uses AI agents to reconcile accounts, review transactions and surface discrepancies. Users can hand off busywork that is "described once, done automatically, reviewed by you," and can run forecasts and AR work as in-app AI tasks, alongside "ask AI" categorization and Accounting AI prompts on the ledger. The external MCP connection to Claude is not counted as the built-in assistant. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of in-app AI task delegation, and in-depth documentation of the AI-task workflow (which task types are supported, setup, limits).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: AI Close helps you automate and accelerate your month-end process using AI agents to reconcile accounts, review transactions, and surface discrepancies.

Hand off the busywork. Finding software subscriptions, matching invoices to payments, pulling together what your accountant needs — described once, done automatically, reviewed by you before anything's final.
You can see runway on the Dashboard, run a forecast as an AI task
You can work in the app, run AI tasks
A user can click on a button and “ask AI” for help in categorizing a transaction —without context switching between tools.
Accounting AI runs prompts on top of your general ledger.
